### DonorDock Pricing Summary (as of March 2026)

DonorDock offers a **single pricing plan called DonorDock ONE** at **$500 per month** (flat rate, annual subscription). Key highlights:
- **Unlimited contacts, users, and features** (no tiers or hidden costs).
- **No contracts**; month-to-month flexibility.
- **Free trial** available.
- Transparent pricing confirmed across official site, G2, GetApp, and Capterra.

#### Included Features
| Category | Details |
|----------|---------|
| **Core Tools** | Unlimited donor records, gift tracking, reporting/dashboard, volunteer/event/grant management. |
| **Online Giving** | Unlimited custom donation pages; integrates with Stripe, QuickBooks, Eventbrite, etc. |
| **Outreach** | Email marketing, automations. |
| **Other** | 1% platform fee on transactions (see below); no limits on capacity. |

#### Transaction Fees (Online Giving via DonorDock Pages)
- **Processing**: Standard Stripe nonprofit rates (typically ~2.2% + $0.30; varies by card).
- **Platform Fee**: **1% flat** (per official site). However, Help Center notes **donor-funded option** of **5% + $0.30 per transaction**:
  - Donors can opt to cover it (suggested at checkout).
  - If not covered, **nonprofit pays only Stripe processing—no DonorDock platform fee**.
- Comparison to competitors (from DonorDock docs):
  | Platform | Platform Fee |
  |----------|--------------|
  | DonorDock | 1% (or donor-funded 5% + $0.30) |
  | Network for Good | 3% |
  | Donorbox | 2.9% + $0.30 |

#### Alternatives Mentioned
For context, cheaper options include:
- **Zeffy CORE**: Starting at $119/month.
- **Little Green Light**: $45/month (up to 2,500 contacts).

**Sources**: Official DonorDock site ([1], [6], [10]), G2 ([2]), GetApp ([3]), Capterra ([4]), Help Center ([5], [7]). Pricing last updated March 2026; contact DonorDock for custom quotes or demos.
